premises.text: Physical-world businesses need accurate bill validation, line-item coding, and accounting entry as the source of truth for costs
premises.evidence_span: bills and receipts are the source of truth for your costs

premises.text: Most businesses fail at AP because bills are complex and disconnected functions cannot pass captured data across the organization
premises.evidence_span: the vast majority of businesses cannot execute these fundamental steps

premises.text: Spatial mapping, proprietary indexing, deterministic language models, and one-shot learning extract and reconcile rich bill data without manual entry
premises.evidence_span: we extract more than 50,000 data points from every page, the characters, and their relation to one another

premises.text: Smart routing sends bills only to required approvers and one-click coding assigns customer, job, and accounting codes
premises.evidence_span: ensure the smart routing of this bill only to the people in the organization who need to review and opine on it

premises.text: Approved bills auto-create accounting records and support flexible single-click payment scheduling including net-term discounts
premises.evidence_span: a single click approves the bill, auto-creates the associated record in the accounting system

premises.text: An integrated contextual data thread gives project managers and accounting shared visibility across validation and payment
premises.evidence_span: we can push this contextual data thread all the way through the process
